audience_question: Which shuttle option meets the minimum range at the lowest upfront cost?
fit_rationale: A same-criteria table compares range, upfront cost, and annual energy cost for every option, while a clear callout identifies the least expensive option that reaches the 200 km threshold.
tradeoff: Showing annual energy cost alongside the decision criteria adds context but can compete visually with the primary range-and-upfront-cost comparison.
caveats: Cedar costs less upfront but falls short of the 200 km minimum.
Annual energy estimates assume 18,000 km of service per vehicle and exclude maintenance and charging-infrastructure costs.
All figures are fictional estimates from one procurement worksheet; no uncertainty ranges were provided.
